content.title: When is the World Baseball Classic championship? Time, TV schedule, channel, live stream for 2026 WBC final | Sporting News
content.text: If you purchase a product or register for an account through one of the links on our site, we may receive compensation. Learn more > The twists and turns of the 2026 World Baseball Classic already have produced numerous memorable moments, with more still to come as a champion is crowned. One thing we already know is a new team will lift the trophy this year after reigning champion Japan fell to Venezuela in the quarterfinals. Japan won three of the previous five WBCs, so its failure to even reach the semis was a shock. The only other nations with a title to their credit are the United States and the Dominican Republic, and Team USA will try to add a second title to go with its 2017 crown after squeaking past the D.R. in the first semifinal. Venezuela ended Italy's magical run in the other semi and is guaranteed its best WBC finish after previously topping out in third place in 2009. But when is that final matchup? Here's everything you need to know about the 2026 WBC finale. When is the World Baseball Classic championship?Date: Tuesday, March 17Time: 8 p.m. ETThe 2026 World Baseball Classic championship game is set to begin at 8 p.m. ET on Tuesday, March 17. The game will be played at loanDepot Park in Miami.Where to watch World Baseball Classic finalTV channel: FoxLive stream: FuboThe 2026 World Baseball Classic championship game will be broadcast by Fox and can be streamed live via Fubo.
